description: This Java abstract class, AbstractBasicDBMapper, provides functionality for mapping MongoDB BSON documents and arrays into a JSON value representation. It supports customizable key name revision during the mapping process, encapsulating logic for transforming BSON types to JSON types.

classes.name: AbstractBasicDBMapper
classes.description: An abstract class that maps BSON documents and arrays to JSON values with a customizable key name reviser.

methods.name: mapBsonDocumentToJsonObject
methods.description: Converts a BSON document to a JSON object, applying key revisions.

methods.name: mapBsonArrayToJsonArray
methods.description: Converts a BSON array to a JSON array, applying key revisions.

methods.name: reviseKeyName
methods.description: Revises the key name of a JSON object field using the provided key reviser function.

methods.name: mapBsonValueToJsonValue
methods.description: Maps a BSON value to a JSON value, handling various BSON types including primitives, documents, arrays, and timestamps.

methods.name: mapBsonNumberToJsonNumber
methods.description: Converts a BSON number to a JSON number, preserving the numeric type.
